2609.03871.title: Bioinfoysis Technical Report
2609.03871.paper_summary: Large language model agents have shown promise in bioinformatics, but most existing systems focus primarily on producing final answers, treating planning, tool use, and code execution as transient interactions. This design is poorly suited to long-horizon bioinformatics tasks, where conclusions must remain connected to the data, computations, and intermediate evidence that support them. We introduce \textbf{Bioinfoysis}, a multi-agent harness that represents each request as a persistent, artifact-grounded analysis run. Bioinfoysis combines global planning with step-wise, evidence-driven replanning: the planner maintains an executable checklist and revises pending steps using structured handoffs returned after each worker execution. These handoffs bind intermediate results to their responsible agent, checklist step, and plan generation, preventing stale evidence from being silently reused after replanning. A controlled runtime validates generated scripts, tables, and figures before they are used in downstream analysis or reporting, while role-specific context, persistent memory, and governed bioinformatics skills support reliable execution over long analysis trajectories. We evaluate Bioinfoysis on BixBench and two question-answering tracks of LAB-Bench 2. On BixBench, Bioinfoysis achieves state-of-the-art accuracy of 82.4\%. Across four underlying language models, Bioinfoysis increases average accuracy from 27.81\% to 64.13\% on SeqQA2 and from 3.13\% to 31.25\% on DbQA2. These results demonstrate that reliable bioinformatics automation depends not only on model capability, but also on the harness that governs planning, execution, memory, and evidence flow. We hope that the emergence of Bioinfoysis will play a driving and leading role in the development of the bioinformatics community. Our demo website can be seen in https://report.bioinfoysis.com/.
2609.03871.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型代理在生物資訊學中顯示出潛力，但大多數現有系統主要專注於產生最終答案，將規劃、工具使用和代碼執行視為短暫的互動。這種設計不適合長期的生物資訊學任務，在這些任務中，結論必須與支持它們的數據、計算和中間證據保持連接。我們介紹了\textbf{Bioinfoysis}，這是一個多代理系統，將每個請求表示為持久的、基於工件的分析運行。Bioinfoysis結合了全局規劃與逐步的、基於證據的重新規劃：規劃者維護一個可執行的檢查清單，並在每次工作者執行後使用結構化的交接來修訂待處理步驟。這些交接將中間結果綁定到其負責的代理、檢查清單步驟和計劃生成，防止過時的證據在重新規劃後被默默重用。受控的運行時在生成的腳本、表格和圖形被用於下游分析或報告之前進行驗證，而角色特定的上下文、持久記憶和受管控的生物資訊技能支持在長期分析軌跡上的可靠執行。我們在BixBench和LAB-Bench 2的兩個問答追蹤上評估了Bioinfoysis。在BixBench上，Bioinfoysis達到了82.4\%的最先進準確率。在四個基礎語言模型中，Bioinfoysis將SeqQA2的平均準確率從27.81\%提高到64.13\%，將DbQA2的平均準確率從3.13\%提高到31.25\%。這些結果表明，可靠的生物資訊自動化不僅依賴於模型能力，還依賴於管理規劃、執行、記憶和證據流的系統。我們希望Bioinfoysis的出現能在生物資訊學社群的發展中發揮推動和領導作用。我們的演示網站可以在https://report.bioinfoysis.com/上查看。
